chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Fudayl ibn Uthman, from Layth ibn Abi Sulaym, who raised the chain, he said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Illuminate your houses by the recitation of the Quran, and do not make them (like) graves as the Jews and the Christians did — they prayed in their churches and synagogues and left their houses idle. For indeed, the house in which the recitation of the Quran is frequented, its goodness increases, its inhabitants are provided for abundantly, and it shines for the inhabitants of the heavens just as the stars of the sky shine for the inhabitants of the earth.

key_terms.أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ: People of the heavens — angels who observe and witness
key_terms.تِلَاوَة: Tilawa — recitation of the Quran with proper intonation
key_terms.قُبُوراً: Graves — silent, dark, devoid of dhikr; a metaphor for spiritual desolation
key_terms.نَوِّرُوا: Illuminate/brighten — an imperative to bring spiritual light

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about reciting the Quran at home?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) instructs believers to enliven their homes through Quranic recitation, contrasting this with the practice of Jews and Christians who limited their worship to communal buildings and neglected their homes. The hadith promises three blessings for homes filled with Quran recitation: increased goodness, expanded provision for inhabitants, and a celestial radiance visible to angels — likened to how stars illuminate the earthly world. This teaching was directed at the early Muslim community to establish a culture of home-based worship alongside mosque attendance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Fuzayl Bin Usman, from Lays Bin Abu Suleym, raising it,

‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Illuminate your houses by the recitation of the Quran and do not be taking it as graves just as the Jews and the Christians did. They pray in their churches and the synagogues, and they left their houses as inactive, for the house, when the recitation of the Quran is frequented in it, would be of abundant goodness, and (sustenance of) its inhabitants would be Expanded, and it would shine for the inhabitants of the sky just as the stars shine for the inhabitants of the earth’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Fudayl ibn ‘Uthman from Layth ibn abu Sulaym in a marfu’ manner from the Holy Prophet who has said the following: “

Light up your homes by means of reading the Holy Quran and do not turn them into graves as the Jews and Christians had done. They pray in churches and synagogues and leave their homes of no use. If reading of the Holy Quran is more often in a house, goodness increases therein, its inhabitants receive expanded sustenance and it will shine to the inhabitants of the heaven just as stars shine for the people of this world (earth).’”
